BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP/2023)
CLASS:  BTECH   SEMESTER : VI
BRANCH: EEE   SESSION : SP/2023

SUBJECT:  EE463 SPECIFICATIONS & ESTIMATION OF ELECTRICAL INSTALLATIONS

TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q.1(a) What are the factor effecting the selection of wiring? [2]
Q.1(b) What is the difference between Casing and capping wiring? [3]


Q.2(a) Explain the advantage and disadvantages of concealed wiring. [2]
Q.2(b) What are the selection criteria for selecting the electric wire. [3]


Q.3(a) Find a Simple diagram of Single Phase Installation in a room. [2]
Q.3(b) Draw Single  Phase  Installation  with  a  number  of  sub-distributions boards  each  connected  to  the
mains through a separate fuse.
[3]


Q.4(a) What are the objective of earthing? [2]
Q.4(b) Explain the different type of earthing. [3]


Q.5 Prepare  a  layout,  wiring  diagram  and  estimate  for  a  7  HP,  3  phase,  400V  squired  cage motor
proposed to be installed in a workshop of size 5m * 5m at the center with main board mounted at
one corner of workshop.
[5]
